#   The paper models sex × race as a 4-level variable
#   This decomposes cleanly as female=1pt + nonwhite=2pts (additive)
#   we use two independent binary components that the pipeline sums.
#   Reference group <60 years = 0 points (no row needed).
#   domain = "observation" is a valid placeholder; the pipeline routes

#   domain field is used. missing_is_negative = FALSE: a missing

#   value activated in 0/225 patients despite qualifying Synthea events being
#   present: not every concept in this covariate's set (see
#   covariate_concepts.csv) resolves to the observation domain in this
#   every clinical-event domain table rather than trusting this column. See
#   phenotype_library/catalog.yaml :: ambulatory_deficit for the full concept
#   REVISED 2026-10-05: the concept set itself was redefined (gait descriptors
#   and the long-cane procedure dropped; walker / frame / crutch devices
